class: A field hidden from people to catch programs was treated as the applicant's question
symptom: Writer (Ashby), 28 September: 'Enter website. This input is for robots only, do not enter if you're human.' was sent to the AI as a question, spending a request; filled, it would mark the application as a bot's.
site: Ashby (Writer); any site with a honeypot field
root_cause: The accessibility snapshot includes the hidden field, and parse_snapshot read every named text box as a question.
why_tests_missed: No fixture had a honeypot field.
fix: page_agent.is_bot_trap(): a field whose label says it is for robots, or tells a human not to fill it, is not read as a control at all.
prevention: Read what a field says about itself before treating it as a question, and keep a fixture of every kind of trap a site sets.
